{"id":1832664792,"question_id":4084,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763408074,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"97 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1832664792/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Sum of Squares of Digits","memory":"85.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string maxSumOfSquares(int num, int sum) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        int digit_count = 0;\n        int req_sum = sum;\n        int digit = 9;\n        \n        while(digit_count != num)\n        {\n            if(digit <= req_sum) \n            {\n                ans.push_back(digit + '0');\n                req_sum -= digit;\n                digit_count++;\n            }\n            else digit--;            \n        }\n    return (req_sum != 0) ? \"\" : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-sum-of-squares-of-digits","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1137}
